test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'TRAIN' is written as AITRS, and 'TRUCK' is written as UCTRP. How will 'CYCLE' be written in the same language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **First alphabet is placed at 3rd place.

 Second alphabet is placed at 4th place.

 Third alphabet is placed at 1st place.

 Fourth alphabet is placed at 2nd place. 

 Fifth alphabet is increased to 5 positional values.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c57f278fd62bc7d402225880eb35613cadb23068ce27aa5b78d02a6a4cffdcb.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f9e77d396666b84fcb35acef3f1ec52d461ddbfbd81d4415ea699711607b7a6.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ff4d8f6e8515fbb65b63c0d8ffc2b56a25faa2eae211b2641f9231fd9cae3e0.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
